local bot = player.GetBots()[1]
if not IsValid(bot) then RunConsoleCommand("bot") end
local out = { props = {}, has_bot = IsValid(bot) }
local ent = ents.Create("prop_physics")
ent:SetModel("models/props_junk/wood_crate001a.mdl")
ent:SetPos(Vector(823, -500, -100)) ent:Spawn() ent:Activate()
if IsValid(bot) then
  if ent.SetCreator then ent:SetCreator(bot) end
  if cleanup and cleanup.Add then cleanup.Add(bot, "props", ent) end
  if CPPISetOwner then ent:CPPISetOwner(bot) end
end
local ply = IsValid(bot) and bot or nil
for name, p in pairs(properties.List) do
  local filt_prop, filt_bot, filt_world = nil, nil, nil
  if ply then
    local ok, r = pcall(p.Filter, p, ent, ply) filt_prop = ok and (r and true or false) or ("err " .. tostring(r))
    ok, r = pcall(p.Filter, p, bot, ply) filt_bot = ok and (r and true or false) or ("err " .. tostring(r))
    ok, r = pcall(p.Filter, p, game.GetWorld(), ply) filt_world = ok and (r and true or false) or ("err " .. tostring(r))
  end
  out.props[name] = { label = p.MenuLabel, order = p.Order, icon = p.MenuIcon, type = p.Type,
    prop = filt_prop, player = filt_bot, world = filt_world, has_receive = p.Receive ~= nil, has_action = p.Action ~= nil,
    menu_open = p.MenuOpen ~= nil, filter_src = debug.getinfo(p.Filter, "S").short_src }
end
out.cvars = { sbox_godmode = GetConVar("sbox_godmode"):GetString() }
ent:Remove()
return out
